empirical.zh: 實證的、以經驗為根據的

ex.en: There is little empirical evidence for this theory.
ex.zh: 這個理論幾乎沒有實證證據。

ex.en: The study is based on empirical data.
ex.zh: 這項研究是根據實證資料。

ex.en: Saving energy can reduce the emission of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 節約能源可以減少溫室氣體排放到大氣中。

ex.en: As a result of some factories using fossil fuels, chemical emissions have already caused serious environmental problems.
ex.zh: 由於一些工廠使用化石燃料，化學物質的排放已經造成嚴重的環境問題。

ex.en: You can embed the video in your website.
ex.zh: 你可以把影片嵌入你的網站。

ex.en: The chip is embedded in the card.
ex.zh: 晶片嵌在卡片裡。

ex.en: These values are deeply embedded in our culture.
ex.zh: 這些價值觀深植於我們的文化中。

ex.en: That memory is embedded in my mind.
ex.zh: 那段記憶深深烙印在我心裡。

ex.en: The 1960s saw the emergence of the Civil Rights movement in the United States.
ex.zh: 1960 年代，美國興起了民權運動。

ex.en: The emergence of AI has changed many industries.
ex.zh: 人工智慧的興起改變了許多產業。

ex.en: We are seeing the emergence of new competitors in Asia.
ex.zh: 我們看到亞洲出現了新的競爭對手。

ex.en: Managers should empower employees to make decisions.
ex.zh: 主管應該授權員工做決定。

ex.en: The training empowers staff to solve problems themselves.
ex.zh: 這項訓練讓員工有能力自己解決問題。

ex.en: She embodies the spirit of the company.
ex.zh: 她體現了公司的精神。

ex.en: The new design embodies simplicity and elegance.
ex.zh: 新設計展現了簡約與優雅。

ex.en: The program focuses on the empowerment of women.
ex.zh: 這個計畫著重於女性賦權。

ex.en: Employee empowerment can improve job satisfaction.
ex.zh: 授權給員工可以提升工作滿意度。

ex.en: I never answer email messages from people I don't know.
ex.zh: 我從不回覆陌生人寄來的電子郵件。

ex.en: Can you please copy me on that email?
ex.zh: 那封信可以副本給我嗎？

ex.en: I will send it by email this afternoon.
ex.zh: 我今天下午會用電子郵件寄出。

ex.en: I'll email you the report this afternoon.
ex.zh: 我今天下午會把報告用電子郵件寄給你。

ex.en: Please email me if you have any questions.
ex.zh: 如果有任何問題，請寄信給我。

ex.en: A chicken hatches an egg and a chick emerges.
ex.zh: 母雞孵蛋，小雞破殼而出。

ex.en: In the 1960s, the civil rights movement emerged in the United States.
ex.zh: 1960 年代，美國興起了民權運動。

ex.en: New problems emerged during the test.
ex.zh: 測試期間出現了新問題。

ex.en: China is an emerging market.
ex.zh: 中國是新興市場。

ex.en: We are investing in emerging technologies.
ex.zh: 我們正在投資新興科技。

ex.en: It later emerged that the report was wrong.
ex.zh: 後來才發現那份報告是錯的。

ex.en: The truth emerged after the investigation.
ex.zh: 調查後真相浮現了。

ex.en: The company employs 500 workers.
ex.zh: 這家公司僱用了 500 名員工。

ex.en: She employed him as a programmer.
ex.zh: 她僱用他當程式設計師。

ex.en: Six people applied for the job, but none of them were employed.
ex.zh: 有六個人應徵這份工作，但沒有一個被錄取。

ex.en: The grammatical form employed here is the present progressive.
ex.zh: 這裡使用的文法形式是現在進行式。

ex.en: We employ the latest technology in our factory.
ex.zh: 我們的工廠採用最新的技術。

ex.en: This box is empty. It has nothing in it.
ex.zh: 這個箱子是空的，裡面什麼都沒有。

ex.en: The room was empty except for a shabby bed.
ex.zh: 房間裡除了一張破舊的床，什麼都沒有。

ex.en: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
ex.zh: 你尤其不該空腹喝酒。

ex.en: The neighbours see that the mailbox hasn't been emptied.
ex.zh: 鄰居注意到信箱一直沒有清。

ex.en: Please empty the trash before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前請把垃圾倒掉。

ex.en: His promises turned out to be empty.
ex.zh: 他的承諾最後都是空話。

ex.en: I'm tired of empty words.
ex.zh: 我受夠了空洞的話。

ex.en: She found employment as a typist.
ex.zh: 她找到一份打字員的工作。

ex.en: They guaranteed regular employment to their workers.
ex.zh: 他們保證員工能穩定就業。

ex.en: The new factory will create employment for 500 people.
ex.zh: 新工廠將創造五百個就業機會。

ex.en: You should learn to control your emotions.
ex.zh: 你應該學著控制自己的情緒。

ex.en: Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
ex.zh: 愛比較的心態會讓人產生負面情緒。

ex.en: He hid his emotions and pretended to be enthusiastic.
ex.zh: 他隱藏自己的情緒，假裝很熱心。

ex.en: People's emotional lives are becoming more and more unstable.
ex.zh: 人們的感情生活越來越不穩定。

ex.en: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
ex.zh: 我在感情上認同，但在現實層面上不同意。

ex.en: She gave me a lot of emotional support.
ex.zh: 她給了我很多情感上的支持。

emotional.zh: 情緒激動的、易動感情的

ex.en: I didn't mean to get emotional.
ex.zh: 我不是故意要那麼激動的。

ex.en: It is not good for a scientist to get emotional.
ex.zh: 科學家太容易情緒化並不好。

ex.en: He got very emotional during his farewell speech.
ex.zh: 他在告別演說時情緒非常激動。

ex.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
ex.zh: 我想特別強調這一點。

ex.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
ex.zh: 線條藝術強調的是形狀和輪廓，而不是色彩、陰影和質感。

ex.en: My manager emphasized the importance of meeting deadlines.
ex.zh: 我的主管強調了準時交件的重要性。

ex.en: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.
ex.zh: 他強調教育的重要性。

ex.en: I would like to place particular emphasis on this point.
ex.zh: 我想特別強調這一點。

ex.en: This point deserves special emphasis.
ex.zh: 這一點值得特別強調。

ex.en: I didn't mean to embarrass you.
ex.zh: 我不是故意讓你難堪的。

ex.en: You'll embarrass her.
ex.zh: 你會讓她很尷尬。

ex.en: Tom was embarrassed to have to ask for help.
ex.zh: 湯姆不好意思開口求助。

ex.en: Tom embraced his son.
ex.zh: 湯姆擁抱他的兒子。

ex.en: Tom embraced his father.
ex.zh: 湯姆擁抱了他的父親。

ex.en: He spread his arms as though wanting to embrace the world.
ex.zh: 他張開雙臂，彷彿要擁抱全世界。

ex.en: Our company embraces new technology.
ex.zh: 我們公司樂於接納新科技。

ex.en: She embraced the chance to work abroad.
ex.zh: 她欣然把握到國外工作的機會。

ex.en: They greeted each other with a warm embrace.
ex.zh: 他們熱情地擁抱彼此打招呼。

ex.en: He held his daughter in a long embrace.
ex.zh: 他緊緊抱著女兒好久。

ex.en: They built their empire in Peru about five hundred years ago.
ex.zh: 他們大約五百年前在秘魯建立了帝國。

ex.en: They increased the territory of the empire.
ex.zh: 他們擴張了帝國的領土。

ex.en: He built a business empire from a small shop.
ex.zh: 他從一家小店起家，打造出商業帝國。

ex.en: The family owns a media empire.
ex.zh: 這個家族擁有一個媒體王國。

emit.zh: 排放、發出（光、熱、氣體、聲音）

ex.en: Cars emit large amounts of carbon dioxide.
ex.zh: 汽車排放大量二氧化碳。

ex.en: The device emits a beep when the battery is low.
ex.zh: 電池電量低時，這個裝置會發出嗶聲。

ex.en: The factory was fined for emitting toxic gases.
ex.zh: 這家工廠因排放有毒氣體而被罰款。

ex.en: The princess begged forgiveness from the emperor.
ex.zh: 公主向皇帝請求原諒。

ex.en: The Emperor's Birthday fell on Sunday.
ex.zh: 天皇的生日剛好是星期天。

ex.en: The emperor lived in a huge palace.
ex.zh: 皇帝住在一座巨大的宮殿裡。

ex.en: Two thirds of the employees of this company are engineers.
ex.zh: 這家公司三分之二的員工是工程師。

ex.en: Japanese companies generally provide their employees with uniforms.
ex.zh: 日本的公司通常都會為員工提供製服。

ex.en: She's not among the regular employees of this company.
ex.zh: 她不是這家公司的正式員工。

ex.en: Germany is to ban employers from snooping on Facebook.
ex.zh: 德國將禁止雇主在臉書上窺探員工。

ex.en: My employer pays for my health insurance.
ex.zh: 我的雇主幫我付健康保險。

ex.en: In case of emergency, call the police.
ex.zh: 遇到緊急情況請報警。

ex.en: In an emergency, use the stairway, not the elevator.
ex.zh: 緊急時請走樓梯，不要搭電梯。

ex.en: You can contact me in case of emergency.
ex.zh: 緊急情況下，您可以聯絡我。

ex.en: Where is the Japanese Embassy?
ex.zh: 日本大使館在哪裡？

ex.en: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.
ex.zh: 他是美國大使館的外交官。

ex.en: The embassy is located next to the Supreme Court.
ex.zh: 大使館就在最高法院旁邊。
